name: ClinuxFlowPatient
title: ClinuxFlow Patient
description: A patient's demographic record, profiling FHIR R4 Patient. Unlike Facility/Provider, no local ABDM sandbox reference doc exists for ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) issuance in this repo — this profile is grounded in real, general FHIR R4 Patient conventions and ABHA's own well-known public identifier shape, not a cited local API spec; that gap is stated honestly, not papered over. Deliberately staff-mediated capture, not self-registration: SPEC-21 §6 already resolved that Patient never gets a login to this app ('Patient will not have a login... can see his health records via digi-locker no features more than that') — this profile constrains what Front Desk/Consultation Desk capture on a patient's behalf, not a self-service form.

element.comment: Required for real clinical use (dosing, reference ranges) even though ABHA's own KYC step doesn't strictly gate on it.
Real, practical requirement — this is the number an ABHA linkage (OTP-based) and any DigiLocker export flow both key off.
The 14-digit ABHA number, when the patient already has one (or gets one linked during this visit) — genuinely optional at capture time; a walk-in patient without ABHA yet must still be registerable.
The human-friendly ABHA address ('name@abdm'), a separate real identifier from the numeric ABHA number itself.
Narrowed from base FHIR's 0..* — one current address is what this app's own capture surfaces (Front Desk/Consultation) actually ask for.
